scope: nested-lab transport integrity, not VMware product behavior

symptoms: ESXi reported qemu-shared as Mounted=true but Accessible=false
Linux nfsd repeatedly logged RPC fragment too large

fix: Set vnet_hdr=off on the QEMU management TAP netdev.
Disable checksum, TSO, GSO, GRO, VLAN and GRO-list offloads independently on both TAP and bridge.
Re-export the shared directory idempotently whenever an ESXi QEMU instance starts.
Restart the NFS server and remount the datastore to discard corrupt TCP record streams.
